```{bash}
# https://www.arb-silva.de/archive/release_132/Exports
```

```{bash}
conda activate ghost_tree
```

```{bash}
mkdir ../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree
```

```{bash}
# Please verify that you have MUSCLE v3.* installed, 
# since newer versions of MUSCLE are not compatible with Ghost-tree
muscle --version
```

### Create a phylogenetic tree for 16S

```{bash}
# inputs
OTU_FILE='../../data/data_analysis/ps_microbiome.otu.csv'
TAXONOMY_FILE='../../data/data_analysis/ps_microbiome.taxonomy.csv'
# outputs
OTU_FILE_RENAMED='../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/ps_microbiome.otu.renamed.csv'
TAXONOMY_FILE_RENAMED='../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/ps_microbiome.taxonomy.renamed.csv'
TAXONOMY_FILE_GHOST='../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/ps_microbiome.taxonomy.ghost_tree.csv'
TAXONOMY_FASTA_FILE='../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/ps_microbiome.taxonomy.fasta'
TAXONOMY_ALIGNED_FASTA_FILE='../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/ps_microbiome.taxonomy_aligned.fasta'
TREE='../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/ps_microbiome.tree.nwk'
```

```{bash}
python scripts/convert_taxonomy_to_fasta.py \
    $OTU_FILE \
    $TAXONOMY_FILE \
    $OTU_FILE_RENAMED \
    $TAXONOMY_FILE_RENAMED \
    $TAXONOMY_FILE_GHOST \
    $TAXONOMY_FASTA_FILE 
```

```{bash}
muscle -in $TAXONOMY_FASTA_FILE \
       -out $TAXONOMY_ALIGNED_FASTA_FILE \
       -maxiters 2 -diags1
```

```{bash}
fasttree -nt -quiet $TAXONOMY_ALIGNED_FASTA_FILE > $TREE
```

### Create a phylogenetic tree for ITS

```{bash}
wget -P ../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree \
    https://www.arb-silva.de/fileadmin/silva_databases/release_132/Exports/SILVA_132_SSURef_Nr99_tax_silva_full_align_trunc.fasta.gz
wget -P ../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree \
    https://www.arb-silva.de/fileadmin/silva_databases/release_132/Exports/taxonomy/tax_slv_ssu_132.acc_taxid
wget -P ../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree \
    https://www.arb-silva.de/fileadmin/silva_databases/release_132/Exports/taxonomy/tax_slv_ssu_132.txt
```

### Prepare SILVA backbone data

```{bash}
# inputs
SILVA_DB_ALIGN="../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/SILVA_132_SSURef_Nr99_tax_silva_full_align_trunc.fasta.gz"
SILVA_TAX_MAP="../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/tax_slv_ssu_132.txt"
SILVA_TAX_ACC_TAXID="../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/tax_slv_ssu_132.acc_taxid"
# outputs
SILVA_DB_ALIGN_FASTA="../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/SILVA_132_SSURef_Nr99_tax_silva_full_align_trunc.fasta"
SILVA_FUNGI_ONLY_FILE="../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/silva_fungi_only.txt"
SILVA_FUNGI_ONLY_FILTERED_FILE="../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/silva_fungi_only_filtered.txt"
```

```{bash}
gunzip -k $SILVA_DB_ALIGN 
```

```{bash}
ghost-tree silva extract-fungi \
    $SILVA_DB_ALIGN_FASTA \
    $SILVA_TAX_ACC_TAXID \
    $SILVA_TAX_MAP \
    $SILVA_FUNGI_ONLY_FILE
 
```

```{bash}
ghost-tree filter-alignment-positions \
    $SILVA_FUNGI_ONLY_FILE \
    0.9 0.8 \
    $SILVA_FUNGI_ONLY_FILTERED_FILE 
```

### Prepare UNITE database and taxonomy annotations

```{bash}
# inputs
# neccesary to provide a path to the same database, used for the ITS reads annotation 
DATABASE_PATH='../../data/database/UNITE'
UNITE_DB=$DATABASE_PATH'/sh_general_release_dynamic_s_19.02.2025_dev.fasta' 
OTU_FILE='../../data/data_analysis/ps_mycobiome.otu.csv'
TAXONOMY_FILE='../../data/data_analysis/ps_mycobiome.taxonomy.csv'
# outputs
UNITE_TAX_FILE='../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/sh_general_release_dynamic_s_19.02.2025_dev.ghost_tree.fasta'
OTU_FILE_RENAMED='../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/ps_mycobiome.otu.renamed.csv'
TAXONOMY_FILE_RENAMED='../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/ps_mycobiome.taxonomy.renamed.csv'
TAXONOMY_FILE_GHOST='../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/ps_mycobiome.taxonomy.ghost_tree.csv'
TAXONOMY_FASTA_FILE='../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/ps_mycobiome.taxonomy.fasta'
```

```{bash}
grep ">" $UNITE_DB \
    | tr -d '>' \
    | awk -F'\|k__' '{print $1 "|k__" $2}' \
    | awk -F'\|k__' '{print "'"'"'" $1 "'"'"'" "\t" "k__" $2}' \
    > $UNITE_TAX_FILE 
```

```{bash}
python scripts/convert_taxonomy_to_fasta.py \
    $OTU_FILE \
    $TAXONOMY_FILE \
    $OTU_FILE_RENAMED \
    $TAXONOMY_FILE_RENAMED \
    $TAXONOMY_FILE_GHOST \
    $TAXONOMY_FASTA_FILE 
```

### Building a Tree

```{bash}
# outputs
UNITE_DB_EXTENSIONS_FILE='../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/unite_db_tree_extensions.txt'
GHOST_TREE_OUT="../../data/data_analysis/ghost_tree/ghost_tree"
```

```{bash}
# Grouping the UNITE database tree extensions
ghost-tree extensions group-extensions \
    $TAXONOMY_FASTA_FILE \
    0.5 \
    $UNITE_DB_EXTENSIONS_FILE
```

```{bash}
# Building combining Silva backbone with UNITE tree extensions into a final tree
ghost-tree scaffold hybrid-tree-foundation-alignment \
    $UNITE_DB_EXTENSIONS_FILE \
    $TAXONOMY_FILE_GHOST  \
    $TAXONOMY_FASTA_FILE \
    $SILVA_FUNGI_ONLY_FILTERED_FILE \
    $GHOST_TREE_OUT
```
